title: AI Coding Governance, Security & Control | viewtower.ai
excerpt: Govern Claude Code and Codex with company-wide policies. Protect secrets, monitor AI coding activity and optimize costs—without limiting developer freedom.
content_html:
The All-in-One AI-Coding Governance Platform

Take Control of  
AI Coding

One platform to monitor, secure, and govern AI coding across your organization. Empower your team to use AI-Coding Tools with company-wide guardrails and without losing control.

BUILT BY THE TEAM THAT'S TRUSTED BY

Works with your Development Stack

Claude CodeCodexGitHub CopilotCursorOpenCodeGitHubGitLabAzure DevOps

01 / The control gap

AI-Coding is a Blackbox.
Open IT!

Your developers use AI coding tools. But do you know what the AI Tools accessed, what Lines they generated, or which company secrets they have sent to the cloud without any one noticing?

02 / RISK & COMPLIANCE

AI Regulations Keep Changing. Stay ahead!

The EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, and many more regulations are here to stay. Start tracking AI coding activity today, so you have the evidence you need tomorrow.

01

Track every activity

Record what your AI coding agents do across every developer device — automatically and in real time.

02

Add and save with your code base

Store the evidence alongside your code base, so it stays with the work it belongs to.

03

Create sophisticated reports

Turn the recorded activity into audit-ready reports whenever you need them.

Audits & Reporting

Every action documented. Every report ready when you need it.

AI Code Attribution

Know which code was generated by AI and get a report from it.

Evidence Retention

Keep records available for future reviews.

03 / Maximize ROI

Token costs rise.
Safe your money using Less!

Ever token that is generated but not needed is wasted money. Leaner context, the right model for every task with same quality means: 
You save Money and maximize your ROI.

Smart Token Optimization

Save real Money with every session.

AI coding tool responses often contain more information than the model needs. Our platform automatically removes unnecessary context before it reaches the LLM, reducing token consumption by up to 10% per session. WITH the same output quality.

Intelligent Model Routing

Your developers won't notice. Your AI bill will.

04 / Vendor Independence

You've Been Locked In Before.
Don't Make the Same Mistake with AI Coding.

Without independent governance

Your Vendor. Their Rules.

Your entire engineering organization depends on one AI provider. When prices rise, capabilities change, or policies shift, your options are limited.

  • Dependent on one provider's pricing
  • Limited flexibility to adopt better tools
  • Governance tied to vendor-specific controls

With independent governance

Your Company. Your Rules.

Define your own AI coding playbook. Choose which tools your teams can use, set company-wide guardrails, and stay free to adapt as the market evolves.

  • Freedom to choose between AI providers
  • Flexibility to adopt better tools anytime
  • One governance playbook across supported tools

05 / Ownership & Freedom of Tool Choice

Your Team knows best.
Let Them Decide!

Your developers know which AI coding tools work best for each task. Give them the freedom to choose from approved tools, while you define the guardrails that keep everything secure, monitored, and compliant.

Your company sets the guardrails. Your developers make the choices.

Company-wide governance

Our mission

This platform was built by developers who value freedom and ownership. But we've also seen the chaos, unpredictability, and risks that come with uncontrolled AI coding tools. That is why we designed this governance platform that gives organizations maximum control without taking away developers' freedom.

Governance shouldn't restrict innovation.
It should keep it Safe.

Dominik Rampelt

CEO & Co-Founder
